gig_title: Create a Cinematic Video With Expertise and AI
description:
AI tools are powerful—without real direction they fall flat. I guide the creative process from concept to final master, combining AI generation with professional post. Every second is paced, scored, and graded to look like a finished film—not a tech demo.

WHAT YOU GET:
• Direction, concept, and pacing by a human storyteller
• AI-enhanced visuals (Sora/Veo-style pipeline)
• Real sound design and color work for emotional impact
• HD delivery (720p–1080p) tuned for YouTube, socials, or campaigns

Hybrid workflow—AI speed with film logic. The result is cinematic, intentional, and entirely yours.
